meta.title: Avoid reopening /dev/kvm or /dev/mshv for every new sandbox
meta.body_summary: Cache /dev/kvm and /dev/mshv file handles using OnceLock globals to avoid reopening device files for every new sandbox, claiming significant reduction in file operations.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added handle caching with tests after review, but PR was closed in favor of existing human PR #469 as a Copilot experiment.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 252 changed lines across 5 files, this is a small, concentrated refactor. As a small-step performance PR it was closed—not merged—because an alternative human PR (#469) superseded the work.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer simongdavies CHANGES_REQUESTED: 'Please add some tests for this new functionality'. Copilot responded with unit tests in subsequent commits.
review_details.performance_claim: Avoid reopening /dev/kvm or /dev/mshv for every new sandbox, reducing file operations and speeding up sandbox creation.
review_details.antipattern_addressed: repeated_io (reopening device files for each sandbox)
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer closed PR with note 'Closing in favour of #469, this was a good test of copilot coding agent'.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: PR closed despite being functionally correct and addressing review feedback, because an alternative human PR (#469) existed; Copilot's work was treated as an experiment.

detection_detail.code_reading: simongdavies reviewed the handle caching logic and requested tests; no benchmark or profiling evidence was required.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after timing data or benchmark; only a narrative claim of significant reduction in file operations.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed because alternative PR #469 superseded the approach, not due to performance regressions; no revert or fix cycle occurred.

core_change_summary.description: Introduced static OnceLock globals KVM_HANDLE and MSHV_HANDLE in kvm.rs and hyperv_linux.rs to cache hypervisor device handles; modified driver constructors and is_hypervisor_present() to reuse cached handles instead of opening new file descriptors each sandbox.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Unit tests for handle caching were added to these three files in a later commit.
change_trajectory: Initial implementation (1e2faa8) cached KVM and MSHV handles using OnceLock globals.
Fix commit (a4f3a30) resolved type mismatches in the caching implementation.
Test commit (407ea32) added unit tests for handle reuse.
Several rebase/merge commits attempted to keep branch up to date; PR eventually closed.
